name: Elimination Tournament
description: Multi-round survival game: respond, vote, eliminate the lowest-scoring players, repeat. Last one standing wins.
tagline: Perfect for high-energy competitions and 'last one standing' classroom games.

prompt.label: Prompt students will answer each round
prompt.helper: Same prompt every round — students give a fresh answer each time.
prompt.placeholder: What's a creative use for a paper clip?

rounds.label: Number of rounds
rounds.helper: Each round eliminates the bottom-scoring players. Final round crowns the winner.

elimPercent.label: Percent eliminated each round
elimPercent.helper: Bottom percent (by votes received) gets eliminated.

template.name: Tournament: ${prompt}
template.description: An elimination tournament built with the Elimination Tournament recipe.

round-intro.message: Round {{_loop.eliminate.iteration}} of {{_loop.eliminate.total}} — answer the prompt and survive the vote!
